Requirements: Completed application; Official transcripts from all universities attended reflecting a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0; Two letters of recommendation (one of which should be from a professor familiar with the applicant’s academic performance, if possible); A written statement of professional goals (300–500 words in length, describing how personal and professional experiences have prepared them for graduate study and how graduate study will help them meet professional goals); A professional resume. Additionally, applicants must hold a master’s degree from a regionally accredited institution, possess a 3.0 cumulative GPA from their master’s degree, and hold a valid teaching certificate.
Department: College of Education and Human Development
Concentration: Learning Disabilities, Intellectual Disabilities, Autism Spectrum Disorders
Description: The Sixth-Year Degree in Special Education prepares professional educators with advanced knowledge and skills in special education. The program is designed for certified teachers who wish to advance their professional preparation by earning a Sixth-Year Degree. Students may complete the program with an emphasis in learning disabilities, intellectual disabilities, or autism spectrum disorders. Students are required to complete 30 credits of coursework including a capstone project.
ScholarshipType: President’s Scholarship, Provost’s Scholarship, Dean’s Scholarship, Graduate Assistantships, External Scholarships

Requirements: An official graduate transcript from an accredited college or university showing completion of an M.A. or M.S. degree. Graduate GPA of 3.0 or higher. A completed online application. Two professional letters of recommendation. A current resume. A personal statement describing your interest in the program and plans for using the degree.
Description: This advanced certificate is a sixth-year degree program designed for certified teachers looking to gain specialized expertise in the area of Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics (STEAM) education. Teachers in this program will develop the knowledge and skills necessary to create and implement an integrated STEAM curriculum through inquiry-based learning, problem-solving, and critical thinking. The program will prepare educators to become leaders and innovators in STEAM education, capable of designing engaging and effective learning experiences for diverse student populations across different grade levels. Graduates will be equipped to teach STEAM in various educational settings, including K-12 schools, informal learning environments, and higher education. The program focuses on instructional strategies, curriculum development, and assessment methods specifically tailored to STEAM subjects. The curriculum emphasizes hands-on projects, collaborative learning, and the integration of technology to foster creativity and innovation among students.

Requirements: To enroll in our boot camp, you must: 1. Be at least 18 years old. 2. Have a high school diploma or equivalent. 3. Complete an application. 4. Participate in a phone interview with an admissions representative. 5. Pass a critical thinking assessment.
Description: The Sacred Heart University Coding Boot Camp is a non-credit certificate program designed to help students learn the skills necessary to become a full-stack developer in a hands-on, immersive learning environment. Students will gain practical experience with modern development tools and techniques, including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, Express.js, Node.js, React.js, Database Theory, MySQL, Command Line, Git, and Heroku. The program features challenging exercises, group projects, and portfolio development, preparing students for an entry-level position as a front-end or back-end web developer or to launch their own entrepreneurial venture. The program requires 24 weeks of part-time study or 12 weeks of full-time study and is delivered in a remote, synchronous format. Upon successful completion of the program, students will receive a certificate of completion from Sacred Heart University.

Requirements: Admission to the Certificate in Computer Science Education (110) requires: A completed application for admission, Official transcripts for all undergraduate and graduate coursework documenting a bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited institution, A minimum undergraduate GPA of 3.0, A professional résumé, A statement of purpose (500–1,000 words), Two letters of recommendation, with at least one from a supervisor (professional or academic), An official teaching certificate (or equivalent) in a related area of education.
Description: Sacred Heart University’s Computer Science Education (110) Certificate program is designed to provide teachers who hold a valid Connecticut teaching certificate with an additional endorsement to teach computer science in grades K-12. This program focuses on developing a deep understanding of computer science concepts, computational thinking, and pedagogical strategies essential for effective computer science instruction. The curriculum aligns with the Connecticut State Department of Education (CSDE) standards for computer science education and prepares candidates to pass the Praxis II Computer Science (5008) exam. The program is offered fully online, allowing educators flexibility to pursue their professional development while maintaining their current teaching responsibilities.

Requirements: Students seeking a graduate certificate must meet the general admission requirements for graduate students as outlined in the Graduate Admission section of this catalog. In addition, students must have an undergraduate degree from an accredited institution. Official transcripts from all prior institutions must be submitted. To be considered for admission to a graduate program, an applicant must submit the following: Application for Graduate Admission. Official transcripts of all prior undergraduate and graduate study, with evidence of a baccalaureate degree from an accredited institution. Two letters of recommendation from individuals familiar with the applicant’s academic and/or professional capabilities. A current resume that includes educational background and work experience. A personal statement that describes the applicant’s interest in the program and career goals. Official results of the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) or the Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT) may be required by some programs. Please refer to the specific program admission requirements in this catalog.
Department: John F. Welch College of Business
Description: The Certificate in Corporate Finance is designed for professionals interested in enhancing their understanding of contemporary issues in finance, including valuation, capital budgeting, corporate restructuring, and risk management. With a strong theoretical and practical foundation, students will gain valuable skills in financial analysis and decision-making, preparing them for advanced roles in corporate finance or for pursuing further graduate studies. The program provides an opportunity to complete an intensive specialization in financial management without committing to a full graduate degree.
Accredidation: Sacred Heart University’s Jack Welch College of Business & Technology is AACSB accredited.

Description: The Cybersecurity Certificate is a 15-credit program designed for working professionals who desire to gain essential knowledge and hands-on skills in cybersecurity. This program can be completed in as little as 10 months and is offered both on campus and online. The program is ideal for individuals with a bachelor’s degree in IT, computer science, or a related field, as well as professionals who want to transition into the cybersecurity industry. Upon successful completion of the certificate program, students can pursue an advanced degree such as a Master of Science in Cybersecurity, which would require an additional 15 credits. The curriculum addresses key areas, including an introduction to cybersecurity, network security, ethical hacking and penetration testing, security architecture, and cryptography. The courses are developed using the National Initiative for Cybersecurity Education (NICE) framework, which defines the cybersecurity workforce. As such, students will be well-prepared to take industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, PenTest+, EC-Council CEH, and Cisco CCNA Cyber Ops. Graduates from the program will be qualified to fill positions such as cybersecurity analyst, network security engineer, information security officer, security consultant, ethical hacker, and penetration tester.

Requirements: Students applying for the Database Design Certificate must hold a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution. Applicants must meet the admission standards of the certificate program. Applicants for the graduate certificate program must submit a completed application form, official transcripts of all prior college work (undergraduate and graduate), and two letters of recommendation. Candidates must have an undergraduate GPA of 3.0 or better. International students must satisfy the international student admission standards.
Description: The graduate-level Database Design Certificate program at Sacred Heart University is designed for working professionals seeking to gain the necessary knowledge and skills to develop, implement, manage, and use database systems within a business environment. The program will prepare students for a career as a data analyst, database administrator, or database developer. This program provides students with practical exposure to the conceptual, logical, and physical design of databases, data modeling, SQL, NoSQL, data warehousing, and data mining, along with current issues in database management systems.

Requirements: To be considered for admission into the Digital Marketing graduate certificate program, applicants must hold a bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited institution and have a minimum 3.0 GPA. Those with a GPA below 3.0 may be admitted on a provisional basis. Applicants should submit the following: Online application, Official transcripts of all undergraduate and graduate institutions attended, Two letters of recommendation (professional or academic), A current resume, A 500-word personal statement outlining your career objectives and interest in the program. Applicants must have a working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and a basic understanding of computer functions and applications. Prior work experience in marketing is a plus but not required. International applicants may also be required to submit TOEFL, PTE, or IELTS scores.
Department: Isabelle Farrington College of Education and Human Development; Jack Welch College of Business & Technology
Description: The Welch College of Business & Technology offers a graduate certificate in digital marketing which focuses on social media, content marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), web analytics, and other critical areas of digital marketing. In this 12-credit certificate program, you'll learn how to develop a digital marketing strategy, manage integrated campaigns, and measure campaign effectiveness. Our curriculum provides hands-on experience and real-world projects that will prepare you to make an immediate impact in today's dynamic digital landscape. You’ll be prepared for careers in marketing, advertising, sales, and public relations. This program is designed for marketing professionals looking to update their skills, recent graduates seeking to enhance their job prospects, or individuals transitioning into a marketing role.

Requirements:
Applicants to graduate programs in the Isabelle Farrington College of Education & Human Development must meet the following minimum requirements:
1. An earned bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited institution with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 (on a 4.0 scale).
2. Official transcripts from all post-secondary institutions attended.
3. Two letters of recommendation from individuals able to assess the applicant’s academic and/or professional capabilities. Recommendations should not be from relatives.
4. A completed graduate application form.
5. An interview with a member of the graduate faculty (for select programs).
6. International applicants must demonstrate English language proficiency.
Department: Isabelle Farrington College of Education and Human Development
ScholarshipType: Merit-based, Need-based, Program-specific criteria, Graduate Assistantships, Alumni Discount, SHU Employees & Dependents Tuition Discount, SHU Undergraduate Scholars Discount

Department: John F. Welch College of Business
Description: The Global Investments Certificate program is designed for professionals seeking to enhance their knowledge and skills in global financial markets. This advanced certificate provides a deep understanding of investment strategies, risk management, and international finance. Students will learn to analyze global economic trends, evaluate various investment vehicles, and construct diversified portfolios suitable for a complex international environment. The curriculum covers topics such as global portfolio management, fixed income securities, derivatives, and alternative investments, all with a focus on cross-border applications. Graduates will be prepared for roles in asset management, financial analysis, and international banking.
ScholarshipType: Institutional scholarships, Federal and state programs, Military benefits

Requirements: Official bachelor’s degree transcript from an accredited college or university with a minimum GPA of 3.0. Official transcripts must be sent directly from the institution to Sacred Heart University. Two letters of recommendation (preferred for applicants with a GPA below 3.0). Current professional resume or CV. A personal statement outlining career goals and interest in the program. No GRE or GMAT scores are required for admission. Interview with the program director (as needed).
Department: College of Health Professions and the Jack Welch College of Business & Technology
Description: The Healthcare Administration Graduate Certificate at Sacred Heart University is designed for working professionals who want to enhance their management and leadership skills in the rapidly evolving healthcare industry. This certificate can be completed in as little as one year and provides specialized knowledge in areas such as healthcare policy, finance, and operations. Students will gain a deeper understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing healthcare organizations today and develop the critical thinking and problem-solving abilities needed to excel in administrative roles. This program is ideal for those looking to advance their careers, transition into healthcare management, or pursue a master’s degree in healthcare administration. All courses are delivered online, offering flexibility for busy professionals.

Requirements:
Candidates for admission to the Healthcare Informatics Graduate Certificate must:
Hold a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
Present an official transcript from each institution previously attended.
Have a minimum undergraduate GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale.
Submit a completed application and pay the application fee.
Submit a current resume.
Submit a statement of intent that clearly and concisely describes the applicant’s interest in the program and career goals.
Provide two letters of recommendation (can be academic or professional).
Official GRE scores are not required.
International students must also submit:
Official English translation of all transcripts.
Official TOEFL or IELTS scores for non-native English speakers.
Copy of passport.
Proof of financial support.
Description: The Healthcare Informatics Graduate Certificate provides advanced education in critical concepts of health informatics for healthcare professionals. This program addresses the emerging need to prepare professionals with the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to improve healthcare delivery, clinical outcomes, and patient safety through the effective use of information technology. The curriculum is designed to help students master various facets of health informatics within the complex and ever-changing healthcare environment. Topics covered include foundational concepts in health informatics, data analysis, electronic health records, health information exchange, and the legal and ethical implications of health information technology. Upon successful completion of the certificate, students will be prepared to contribute to the design, implementation, and management of health information systems, enhancing organizational efficiency and patient care.
ScholarshipType: Graduate Assistantships, Tuition Waivers for Employees

Requirements:
Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited institution, with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0. A limited number of applicants with a GPA between 2.5 and 2.99 may be admitted conditionally. Applicants must submit the following:
1. A completed application
2. Official transcripts from all prior institutions
3. An essay (see description below)
4. Two professional recommendations
5. A professional resume
Essay: A statement (500–1,000 words) on professional goals and reasons for pursuing a graduate certificate in Human Resource Management at Sacred Heart University.
Transcripts: Transcripts are official when they are sent directly from the institution to Sacred Heart University. An unofficial copy may be accepted for initial review of the application if an official transcript is requested from the prior institution and sent directly to Sacred Heart University. Sacred Heart University reserves the right to deny admission if the unofficial transcript does not match the official transcript.
Conditional Admission: Applicants who have a GPA of 2.5–2.99 and two years of relevant work experience may be admitted conditionally based on a review by the Program Director. The applicant will be required to maintain a 3.0 GPA in the first 9 credits of study. Failure to do so will result in dismissal from the program.
Description: The Human Resource Management Certificate of Advanced Study provides graduate students with the knowledge and skills necessary to effectively lead and manage human capital within organizations. The curriculum is designed for individuals seeking to enhance their expertise in human resource management without committing to a full master's degree program, as well as for those currently enrolled in a master's program who wish to specialize in HR. Students will explore key areas such as talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, employee relations, HR analytics, and strategic HR planning. The certificate emphasizes practical applications and current industry best practices, preparing graduates for diverse roles in HR departments across various sectors. Upon completion, students will be equipped to contribute significantly to organizational success through effective human resource strategies and practices.

Requirements:
The application for admission to graduate study in Computer Science and IT requires the following:

*   Online application
*   Official transcripts from all colleges and universities attended
*   Two letters of recommendation (can be academic or professional)
*   Professional resume
*   Statement of purpose
*   GRE scores are not required.

Applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution. Those with an undergraduate major other than computer science or a closely related field may be required to complete preparatory coursework. Students with deficiencies in foundational knowledge may be required to take additional courses that do not count toward the certificate.

International students must demonstrate English proficiency through either the TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo English Test scores.

All applicants must complete the Graduate Admissions Interview.

Note: International students are not eligible for student visas with a certificate program.
Description: The Intelligent Computing Certificate provides students with graduate-level knowledge and skills in intelligent computing technologies, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data science. The program addresses the theoretical and practical aspects of these technologies, preparing students for careers in fields such as data analysis, machine learning engineering, and AI development.

Requirements: Admission to the Certificate of Advanced Studies in Interactive Multimedia program is open to applicants who hold a bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited institution. Applicants must meet the general requirements for admission to graduate programs at Sacred Heart University, which include completing and submitting the online application, submitting the nonrefundable application fee, official transcripts from all post-secondary institutions attended, and achieving a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 (on a 4.0 scale).
Description: This certificate program offers students an opportunity to develop expertise in areas such as web design, interactive user interfaces, motion graphics, and video production. Students will acquire skills in industry-standard software to design and develop interactive multimedia content across various platforms, including websites, mobile applications, and digital media installations. The program emphasizes hands-on projects and portfolio development, preparing students for careers in digital media, marketing, education, and entertainment. Whether you are looking to enhance your existing skills or transition into the dynamic field of multimedia, this certificate provides a comprehensive and practical foundation.

Requirements: Admission to the Certificate in Intermediate Administrator (092) program requires: Completion of a master's degree from an accredited institution. Master's degrees in Education, Psychology, or Leadership are preferred. A cumulative GPA of at least 3.0 (on a 4.0 scale) in master’s level work. Three or more years of successful, certified teaching experience. A current resume reflecting experience. Connecticut teaching certification in one or more areas. Two letters of recommendation from professional supervisors (one of whom must be your current direct supervisor) who can attest to your leadership potential. Completion of an on-site interview with an Educational Leadership faculty member. Submission of the online application. Official transcripts from all undergraduate and graduate institutions attended.
Description:
Sacred Heart University’s Intermediate Administrator (092) Certification program offers a planned program of study for certified teachers, school psychologists, school social workers, school counselors, and speech language pathologists who aspire to become district or school administrators and leaders in today’s schools. The program provides a conceptual framework for leadership and administration based on the Connecticut Common Core of Teaching and the Intermediate Administrator Certification (092) requirements. The 092 program is a 30-credit planned program of study. Students who have previously earned a 092 certificate are required to apply for the 6th-year certificate, a 30-credit planned program of study for individuals who wish to work toward the 092 certificate.

Mission Statement
The mission of the Sacred Heart University Department of Educational Leadership is to develop and empower highly effective educational leaders who facilitate teaching and learning, are committed to diversity and social justice, promote ethical practice, and lead with compassion.

Program Learning Objectives
Upon completion of the Intermediate Administrator (092) Certification program, candidates will be able to:
*   Apply research-based knowledge regarding effective school leadership through the lens of social justice.
*   Synthesize knowledge of curriculum, instruction, and assessment needed for effective school leadership.
*   Identify the legal, ethical, and practical issues involved in managing school resources.
*   Develop skills needed to lead, engage, and collaborate with families and community members.
*   Evaluate how school leaders foster diversity, equity, and inclusion in schools.
*   Articulate an understanding of how to implement the Connecticut Code of Professional Responsibility for Educators in real-world settings.

Requirements: Online application, Non-refundable application fee, Official transcripts from all institutions attended, A current resume listing all work experience, A personal statement outlining your professional and academic goals, Two letters of recommendation from professional or academic references. The recommendations must include specific information regarding the applicant’s potential for success in a graduate program, as well as an assessment of their communication skills and critical thinking ability.
Department: John F. Welch College of Business
Description: The Leadership Certificate is a 12-credit program designed to meet the needs of current and aspiring leaders who desire to hone their leadership skills. Participants will focus on developing their abilities to motivate and inspire teams, manage conflict, drive change, and make ethical decisions. The program is ideal for professionals seeking to enhance their leadership capabilities in various organizational settings. This certificate can be completed as a standalone credential or can be a pathway to the Master of Science in Organizational Leadership program. All courses are fully online.
ScholarshipType: Federal Direct Loan Programs, State Scholarship and Grant Programs, University-Sponsored Scholarships and Grants, Departmental Scholarships/Assistantships

Requirements: A bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution. Official transcripts from all universities and colleges attended. A minimum undergraduate GPA of 3.0. Two letters of recommendation (can be academic or professional). A resume. A one-page personal statement outlining interest in the program and career goals. GMAT or GRE scores are not required for admission.
Department: Jack Welch College of Business & Technology
Description: The Marketing Certificate is designed for working professionals interested in acquiring foundational marketing knowledge and enhancing their career opportunities. Students will gain knowledge across all marketing functions, including consumer behavior, marketing research, digital marketing, and strategic marketing. Students completing the Certificate will be able to perform critical marketing functions and understand their impact on their organizations.

Requirements: Completed Application. Official transcripts from all universities and colleges attended. The applicant must have earned a bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited institution. A current resume or curriculum vitae. A statement of purpose (500-1000 words). Two letters of recommendation (required for some programs). Application fee (waived for Sacred Heart University alumni, current students, or employees). Official GRE or GMAT scores (required for some programs).
Description: The .NET Technology Graduate Certificate is for individuals who want to enhance their software development skills using the latest Microsoft .NET technologies. The program focuses on developing high-performance, scalable, and secure applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, and other related technologies. Students will gain expertise in building web applications, APIs, and microservices, and deploying them to various platforms, including Azure. The curriculum covers both theoretical concepts and practical applications, preparing students for careers as .NET developers, software engineers, or architects.

Requirements: Master's Degree from a regionally accredited institution (3.0 GPA minimum). OR Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or equivalent from a regionally accredited institution (3.0 GPA minimum).
Description:
The 18-credit graduate certificate in accounting is designed for students with a bachelor’s degree in a non-business discipline, or a business discipline other than accounting, who wish to enter the accounting profession. This certificate program will also provide the necessary accounting credits to sit for the Certified Public Accountant (CPA) exam. Students holding a bachelor’s degree in accounting who are seeking to fulfill the 150-hour CPA requirement should consider the Master of Science in Accounting (MSA) program. Students who wish to enroll in individual courses should seek permission from the MSA/Accounting Certificate Program Director.
Upon successful completion of the Accounting Certificate program, students will be able to:
* Apply accounting principles to business transactions.
* Analyze financial information for decision-making.
* Prepare financial statements in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.
* Use accounting software for financial reporting.
* Understand the ethical responsibilities of accounting professionals.
Accredidation: Sacred Heart University’s Jack Welch College of Business & Technology programs, including graduate certificates, are accredited by AACSB International.

ProgramName: Accounting: Business Analysis & Reporting (BAR) - Graduate Certificate
Requirements: Completed online application, official transcripts from all post-secondary institutions attended, an undergraduate degree in accounting, finance, or a related field from an accredited institution. Students without an undergraduate background in accounting may be required to complete specific undergraduate accounting courses. A minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale. GMAT/GRE is waived for applicants who have: A cumulative undergraduate GPA of 3.0 or higher, a previous master's degree or higher, or three or more years of professional work experience. Applicants who do not meet these criteria are required to submit GMAT/GRE scores.
Description: Sacred Heart University’s Graduate Certificate in Accounting: Business Analysis & Reporting (BAR) provides students with an in-depth understanding of the critical financial and business analysis skills necessary for success in today’s dynamic accounting and finance landscape. This program is designed for accounting professionals, finance professionals, and recent graduates seeking to enhance their analytical capabilities and bridge the gap between traditional accounting practices and modern business intelligence. The curriculum focuses on developing proficiency in data analytics, financial modeling, reporting tools, and the application of technology to solve complex business problems. Graduates will be equipped to transform raw financial data into actionable insights, support strategic decision-making, and effectively communicate findings to stakeholders. This certificate is ideal for those preparing for advanced roles in corporate finance, public accounting, consulting, or any field requiring strong analytical acumen in an accounting context. Additionally, the BAR certificate can serve as a stepping stone for individuals interested in pursuing a Master of Science in Accounting (MSA) or Master of Business Administration (MBA) program at Sacred Heart University.

ProgramName: Accounting: Information Systems, Controls (ISC) & Forensic - Graduate Certificate
Requirements:
Applicants for the graduate certificate in Accounting: Information Systems, Controls & Forensic must meet the following criteria:
*   Baccalaureate degree with an undergraduate cumulative GPA of 3.0 (on a 4.0 scale) or better. Students with a GPA between 2.5 and 2.99 may be admitted conditionally or may be admitted as a non-matriculated student. Non-matriculated students may apply for matriculated status upon successful completion of 6 graduate credits (two courses) with a minimum GPA of 3.0 and with the permission of the Director of the M.S.A. Program.
*   Evidence of completion of coursework equivalent to Sacred Heart University’s undergraduate accounting major or approval of the M.S.A. Program Director.
*   An official transcript from each college/university attended.
*   Two letters of recommendation from professional or academic sources.
*   Resume.
*   Personal statement.
*   There is no GMAT/GRE requirement for admission to the graduate certificate program.
Department: John F. Welch College of Business
Description: As companies look to expand globally, information technology, cyber security, and data analytics remain key challenges. In addition, the increased sophistication of cybercrimes and fraud makes forensic accounting a critical need across all industries. This 15-credit Graduate Certificate will prepare accounting and finance professionals to detect, investigate, and prevent fraud and cybercrimes in an evolving digital business environment. Students will analyze contemporary issues and trends associated with internal controls, governance, enterprise risk management, forensic accounting, cybersecurity, and financial forensics, as well as data analytics techniques related to these areas. Students will learn how to apply technical skills in critical analysis, research, and communication to identify and propose solutions to complex problems in financial reporting, corporate governance, and risk management.

ProgramName: Accounting: Tax Compliance & Planning (TCP) - Graduate Certificate
Requirements:
To be considered for admission to the Accounting: Tax Compliance & Planning (TCP) program, applicants must complete an online application and submit:
* An official transcript from an accredited undergraduate institution.
* A professional resume.
* A personal statement outlining career goals and interest in the Accounting: Tax Compliance and Planning program.
* Official results of the GMAT or GRE (waived for applicants with a graduate degree or with an undergraduate GPA of 3.0 or higher).
* Two letters of recommendation (can be waived under certain circumstances for those applicants with extensive professional experience in accounting or taxation).
* A minimum undergraduate GPA of 2.75.
Department: Jack Welch College of Business & Technology
Description: The Accounting: Tax Compliance & Planning (TCP) Graduate Certificate program prepares students to meet the challenges of the rapidly changing global business environment. This 18-credit program provides students with a foundational knowledge of tax compliance and planning for individuals and corporations. It also examines the tax implications of partnership formation and dissolution, estates, and trusts. This program is ideal for individuals who hold an undergraduate degree in accounting or a related field and wish to gain specialized knowledge in the area of taxation. This program is offered completely online.

Requirements: Admission to the AI Certificate program requires: A bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited institution. An undergraduate cumulative GPA of 2.75 or higher on a 4.0 scale. Successful completion of an undergraduate course in statistics with a grade of "C" or better.
Description:
Artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly transformed the technological landscape, offering innovative solutions across diverse industries. With the increasing demand for skilled AI professionals, the Artificial Intelligence Graduate Certificate at Missouri Southern State University is designed to equip students with the essential knowledge and practical skills required to thrive in this dynamic field. This graduate certificate provides an in-depth exploration of AI concepts, methodologies, and applications, ensuring students are well-prepared to address complex challenges and contribute to cutting-edge advancements.
The Artificial Intelligence graduate certificate is part of the Robert W. Plaster College of Business, which has been granted accreditation by AACSB International. AACSB accreditation is the hallmark of excellence in business education, earned by less than five percent of the world’s business programs.
This graduate certificate is a stand-alone certificate, meaning that it is not attached to a master’s degree program, and students will earn a graduate certificate upon completion of all of the course work. All courses are online.
Accredidation: The Robert W. Plaster College of Business, which houses the Artificial Intelligence graduate certificate, is accredited by AACSB International.

ProgramName: Post-BS Certificate in Patient Safety and Healthcare Quality
Requirements: Applicants to the Certificate in Patient Safety and Healthcare Quality must hold a bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited institution and have an undergraduate GPA of 3.0 or better. Students interested in pursuing the Certificate in Patient Safety and Healthcare Quality must apply through Sacred Heart University's Office of Graduate Admissions. In addition to the official graduate application, applicants must submit the following materials: Official transcripts from all institutions of higher education attended. Two letters of recommendation. A current resume. A personal statement.
Description: The Post-BS Certificate in Patient Safety and Healthcare Quality provides an opportunity for healthcare professionals to enhance their knowledge and skills in key areas of patient safety and quality improvement. The curriculum is designed to meet the growing demand for healthcare professionals who can lead initiatives to improve the quality of care and reduce medical errors. The program integrates theoretical knowledge with practical application, preparing graduates to apply evidence-based strategies in diverse healthcare settings. This certificate also provides students with 15 graduate credits that can be applied to the Master of Science in Patient Safety and Healthcare Quality.

ProgramName: Post-Master's Certificate in Superintendency and Educational System Administration
Requirements:
Applicants for the Post-Master’s Certificate in Superintendency and Educational System Administration must submit the following:
*   Official transcript from an accredited university indicating the award of a master’s degree from an accredited institution.
*   Official transcripts from all other institutions where college credit was earned.
*   Evidence of five years of successful teaching experience and two years of successful administrative experience, certified by the superintendent of schools or designee on school district letterhead.
*   Proof of Connecticut or comparable out-of-state administrator certification (092).
*   Current resume.
*   Two letters of recommendation from professional references who can attest to the applicant’s leadership potential and successful teaching and administrative experience.
*   A written statement of professional goals.
Department: Isabelle Farrington College of Education and Human Development
Description: This 15-credit Post-Master’s Certificate (PMC) in Superintendency and Educational System Administration is an approved State of Connecticut program for individuals who wish to pursue a leadership role in educational system administration (e.g., Assistant Superintendent, Superintendent). The 15-credit program can be completed in approximately one year. Candidates are required to hold a master’s degree from an accredited institution, plus an Intermediate Administrative/Supervisor (092) endorsement or its equivalent. The Post-Master’s Certificate (PMC) in Superintendency and Educational System Administration will prepare individuals to successfully lead a school district in meeting the challenges of the 21st century. The curriculum, course sequence, field experiences, and exit requirements for the PMC in Superintendency and Educational System Administration meet the competencies and standards as defined by the Connecticut State Department of Education (CSDE) and the National Council for the Accreditation of Teacher Education (NCATE) and will prepare candidates for 093 certification. In addition, the PMC program is designed to integrate the mission of Sacred Heart University by fostering an awareness of social justice through the course curriculum, field experiences, and interactions with practitioners.
Accredidation: The curriculum, course sequence, field experiences, and exit requirements for the PMC in Superintendency and Educational System Administration meet the competencies and standards as defined by the Connecticut State Department of Education (CSDE) and the National Council for the Accreditation of Teacher Education (NCATE).

ProgramName: Post-Master's Certificate in Reading Teacher Education
Requirements: Admission to the Post-Master’s Certificate in Reading Teacher Education requires an official transcript indicating successful completion of a master’s degree from an accredited institution. In addition, the following must be submitted with the application: Three letters of recommendation (at least two from academic sources). A personal statement that discusses the applicant’s background and experiences related to the field of reading and literacy. A valid Connecticut teaching certificate or equivalent. A resume detailing professional and academic experiences. An interview may be required.
Description: This certificate program is designed for certified teachers who hold a master's degree and wish to obtain a Connecticut teaching certificate as a Reading and Language Arts Consultant (102) and/or a Connecticut teaching certificate as a Remedial Reading and Remedial Language Arts (097). Candidates also receive training in the administration and supervision of reading programs. This program is a 24-credit graduate level program. It does not lead to an additional master's degree but fulfills the academic requirements for the Connecticut certification.
Accredidation: Approved by the Connecticut State Department of Education.

Requirements: Applicants to the Graduate Certificate in Web Development must possess an earned baccalaureate degree from an accredited institution. Strong academic performance is expected, with a minimum undergraduate GPA of 3.0 required for admission. Applicants are required to submit: 1. Official transcripts from all post-secondary institutions attended. 2. Three letters of recommendation (professional or academic). 3. Resume. 4. Personal statement.
Description: The Web Development Graduate Certificate provides students with the fundamental concepts, theories, and skills in web development, ranging from client-side programming to back-end technologies. Students learn how to create and maintain interactive web pages, web applications, and web services. Students completing the Certificate will be able to develop interactive web applications and services.

ProgramName: Certificate in Computer Science Education Endorsement
Requirements: To be considered for admission to the Computer Science Education Endorsement program, applicants must hold a Bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited institution and a valid teaching certificate. All applicants must submit the following: A completed online application, Official transcripts of all undergraduate and graduate coursework, Copy of valid teaching certificate, Two letters of recommendation (professional or academic), A current resume, A personal statement, Official GRE scores (if undergraduate GPA is below a 3.0)
Department: Isabelle C. and William J. Lepper School of Computer Science and Engineering
Description:
As the world becomes more technology-driven, the demand for computer science education in K-12 schools continues to rise. Sacred Heart University’s Computer Science Education Endorsement program will prepare you to teach foundational computer science concepts to students in elementary, middle, and high school. This 15-credit program provides educators with the knowledge and skills necessary to teach computer science effectively, meeting the growing need for qualified computer science teachers.
Through engaging coursework and practical experiences, you will explore topics such as computational thinking, programming, data analysis, cybersecurity, and the societal impacts of computing. Our curriculum aligns with the Computer Science Teachers Association (CSTA) K-12 Computer Science Standards and the International Society for Technology in Education (ISTE) Standards for Educators.
Upon completion of the program, you will be eligible for the Connecticut Department of Education (CS 105) Computer Science Endorsement, allowing you to teach computer science in Connecticut public schools. Join us at Sacred Heart University and become a leader in computer science education, shaping the next generation of innovators and problem-solvers.

Requirements: Common Application or Sacred Heart University Application, Official high school transcript, Counselor recommendation, Essay, Official SAT or ACT scores (optional for students applying for Fall 2024).
Department: John F. Welch College of Business
Description: An accounting degree from Sacred Heart University is the perfect start to a rewarding career in a dynamic and diverse field. Our program is a leader in accounting education, recognized for its commitment to student success. You will gain a strong foundation in all areas of accounting, including financial accounting, managerial accounting, auditing, taxation, and accounting information systems. As a graduate, you'll be prepared for a variety of roles in public accounting, corporate accounting, government, and non-profit organizations. With a Sacred Heart accounting degree, you'll be well-prepared for the CPA Exam.
Accredidation: The Jack Welch College of Business & Technology is accredited by AACSB International, the premier accrediting agency for business schools worldwide.
ScholarshipType: Merit-based, Athletic, Endowed, Federal Grants, State Grants

Description: A minor in accounting is designed for students seeking a background in financial concepts and the theory and practice of accounting to complement their chosen major field of study. Students will gain an understanding of financial reporting, managerial accounting, and other specialized areas of accounting that can enhance their career prospects across various industries. This minor is suitable for students pursuing careers in finance, business management, entrepreneurship, law, or any field where a solid grasp of financial data and its interpretation is valuable.

Requirements: Completed Common Application or Sacred Heart University Application. Official high school transcript(s) or GED. Official college transcript(s) for any college-level coursework completed for credit. Letter of Recommendation (encouraged). Application Essay (Required for all applicants). First-year applicants applying for fall 2024, spring 2025, and fall 2025 are not required to submit SAT or ACT scores; however, students may still submit scores to be considered for admission. Applicants for the Performing Arts (Dance, Theatre Arts, and Music) programs are required to complete an audition and interview. Auditions will be held on specific dates on campus. Students unable to attend an on-campus audition may submit a video audition. An artistic resume (one-page maximum) is required in advance of the audition. Candidates will submit their artistic resume directly to the performing arts department prior to their audition. Candidates will also submit two short essays (250-500 words each). One essay should be a short personal statement detailing your interest in your program of choice. The second essay should be a response to a prompt from the department.
Description: Sacred Heart University’s Acting BA program provides students with a solid foundation in the techniques of acting, voice, and movement. Through an intensive conservatory-style program, students learn how to connect with other actors, tell a story through movement, and deliver lines effectively. The program fosters creative, intellectual, and professional development and prepares students for a career in the arts or for further graduate study. Students perform in mainstage productions, work on screen projects, create original works, and have opportunities to audition for professional productions and gain real-world experience. Sacred Heart University is a member of the National Association of Schools of Theatre (NAST).
Accredidation: Member of the National Association of Schools of Theatre (NAST)

Description: The acting minor prepares students in the liberal arts to develop skills in the craft of acting through foundational work in movement, voice, improvisation, and scene study. The minor is a practical program intended to prepare students to pursue further training in a conservatory or graduate program, or to enter the profession directly. The Acting minor serves as a gateway to the Theatre Arts major at Sacred Heart University.
AverageScholarshipAmount: More than $35,000 (average financial aid package for freshmen)
ScholarshipAmount: Merit scholarships range from $15,000 to $27,000 annually.

Description: The American Studies minor provides an interdisciplinary approach to the study of the United States, its culture, and its place in the world. It provides a unique lens through which to explore American history, literature, politics, religion, sociology, and other aspects of American life. The minor helps students develop critical thinking and communication skills and prepares them for a wide range of career paths. The American Studies minor is an excellent complement to many majors, including history, political science, English, communication, and sociology. It allows students to delve deeply into the complexities of American society and culture, fostering a deeper understanding of the nation's past, present, and future. Students gain a holistic perspective on America by drawing on diverse academic fields, which enhances their analytical abilities and broadens their intellectual horizons.
ScholarshipType: Merit-based, Endowed, Athletic, University Grants, Pioneer Pride Grants

Description: The Applied Physics minor provides students with a foundational understanding of the principles of physics and their application across various scientific and engineering disciplines. This minor is designed for students interested in augmenting their primary major with a strong background in analytical thinking and problem-solving derived from physical principles. The curriculum emphasizes practical applications, preparing students for careers in research, technology, and industry, or for further graduate studies. Students will explore topics such as mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, and modern physics, gaining hands-on experience through laboratory work and computational tools.
ScholarshipType: Merit-based, Pioneer & Ignatian, Athletic, Endowed, External, SHU Scholars Award

ProgramName: Bachelor of Arts in Art & Design -
Requirements: Students applying for admission to Sacred Heart University must apply through the Common Application or through Sacred Heart University’s online application. Required Documents: Official high school transcripts, Official SAT or ACT scores (see test-optional policy), Letter of Recommendation (optional), Personal Essay (optional), Sacred Heart University’s application or Common Application, Application Fee (waived for Sacred Heart application).
Description: At Sacred Heart University, our Art & Design program provides a diverse and dynamic education that blends traditional techniques with modern technologies. Students develop their artistic voice and technical skills across various mediums, preparing them for creative careers in a rapidly evolving visual landscape. The curriculum emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and hands-on experience, fostering a deep understanding of art history and contemporary design practices. Our faculty, composed of practicing artists and designers, are dedicated to mentoring students and guiding them through a rigorous and rewarding academic journey. Graduates emerge with a comprehensive portfolio, strong foundational knowledge, and the professional acumen necessary to succeed in a wide array of art and design fields.

The Sacred Heart University minor in Art & Design allows students to express themselves visually and develop creative, critical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and technological skills that are applicable to a wide range of career paths. This minor complements any major through an exploration of the elements and principles of design, historical and contemporary art and design movements, and hands-on experience in studio art and digital design. The Art & Design minor prepares students to contribute to the visual culture of their organizations through the development of a creative portfolio and professional writing skills needed to pursue graduate study and/or careers in art, graphic design, and other visual media.
ScholarshipType: Merit-based, Alumni, Athletic, Performing Arts, ROTC

Description: The Art History Minor introduces students to the visual arts of various cultures and periods. Through the lens of art history, students gain a deeper understanding of human society and experience, developing critical thinking, visual analysis, and research skills. A minor in art history complements a variety of majors including studio art, graphic design, history, literature, philosophy, and communications, among others.
ScholarshipType: Merit-Based, Athletic, Music and Theatre Arts, Catholic High School, Diocesan, Alumni

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence -
Requirements: Sacred Heart University accepts either the Common Application or Sacred Heart University Application. To apply for admission, applicants should submit the following: Official high school transcript(s), A letter of recommendation from a school counselor or teacher, An essay or personal statement, Official SAT or ACT scores are optional for applicants entering the fall 2024 and spring 2025 semesters. Students who wish to be considered for the honors program or for direct entry to the doctorate of physical therapy program may still submit scores for consideration.
Description: Sacred Heart University’s Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence is an innovative program that provides students with the foundational and practical knowledge to understand, design, and implement AI systems. This program emphasizes problem-solving and critical thinking, preparing graduates to excel in a rapidly evolving technological landscape. The curriculum includes machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and ethics in AI, ensuring a well-rounded education. Graduates will be equipped to pursue careers in various industries, from healthcare and finance to manufacturing and entertainment, and contribute to the advancement of artificial intelligence.
ScholarshipType: Merit-based, Need-based, Athletic, Performing Arts, Endowed

Requirements: Applicants are required to submit either the Common Application or Sacred Heart University Application and official high school transcript(s). Official SAT and/or ACT scores are optional for most programs, including Biochemistry - BS, as per Sacred Heart University's test-optional policy. Other optional application components include a letter of recommendation, personal essay, interview, and professional resumé.
Description: Our Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry degree provides students with a foundational understanding of the principles of biochemistry, equipping them with the knowledge and skills necessary to pursue advanced studies or careers in various fields, including medicine, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and research. This rigorous program blends biology and chemistry, offering a comprehensive curriculum that explores the molecular basis of life processes. Students in the Biochemistry program will gain a deep understanding of biochemical pathways, molecular genetics, protein structure and function, and experimental techniques. They will develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and laboratory skills essential for success in scientific research and healthcare-related professions.

Requirements:
To be considered for admission as a first-year student, you will need to submit the following:
*   Official high school transcript(s).
*   SAT/ACT scores (optional for students applying for fall 2024, spring 2025, or fall 2025). SHU’s SAT code is 3780. SHU’s ACT code is 0614.
*   One letter of recommendation.
*   Essay or personal statement (optional).
*   Official college transcript(s) (if you have taken college courses while in high school).
*   TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo scores (for international applicants only).
Description: Our comprehensive Bachelor of Science (BS) in Biology program provides you with an intensive, hands-on, research-based experience and the flexibility to explore your interests through concentration options. Through scientific theory, observation, and experimentation, you’ll investigate the natural world at the cellular, organismal, and ecosystem levels. With an emphasis on undergraduate research, our program provides a modern curriculum that prepares you to thrive as a professional scientist or pursue further study in graduate school or health-related professional programs. Our state-of-the-art facilities include analytical and microscopy labs, tissue culture and molecular biology facilities, a greenhouse, and a vivarium, all of which enhance your classroom learning.
ScholarshipType: Academic Merit, Performing Arts, Athletic, Transfer Student, Pioneer Programs

Requirements: To declare the Biology minor, enrolled Sacred Heart University undergraduate students must complete the Declaration of Major/Minor Form available through the Registrar's Office.
Description: A minor in biology is a great complement to many majors. It allows students to develop a strong scientific background in the life sciences without committing to a full major. The biology minor requires six courses (20-24 credits) selected from an approved list of biology courses. The minor allows flexibility so students can tailor the minor to their interests and future career goals. Students will take courses in the core areas of biology, including cell, molecular, organismal, and evolutionary biology, as well as ecology. Additionally, students will develop strong laboratory skills, learn to critically analyze scientific literature, and develop presentation and communication skills.

The Black Studies minor provides students with an interdisciplinary understanding of the global Black experience. The minor is composed of 18 credits across a wide range of disciplines including history, literature, political science, sociology, art history, and more. Through a combination of required and elective courses, students will explore topics such as the history of slavery and colonialism, civil rights movements, contemporary social justice issues, and the rich cultural traditions of Black communities worldwide. Students will develop critical thinking skills, a nuanced understanding of racial dynamics, and an appreciation for the contributions of Black individuals and communities to society. This minor complements a variety of majors and can lead to careers in fields such as education, social work, public policy, journalism, and non-profit organizations. It also serves as excellent preparation for graduate studies in disciplines such as ethnic studies, history, and sociology.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Business Economics -
Requirements: Sacred Heart University accepts applications through the Common Application. Students applying as first-year students for the 2024-2025 academic year will have the option to apply test-optional. Required materials include: Common Application, Official high school transcript, SAT/ACT scores (Optional for 2024-2025 academic year), Counselor recommendation (strongly encouraged), Personal essay (optional).
Department: John F. Welch College of Business
Description: The Bachelor of Science in Business Economics program teaches students to apply economic principles and quantitative methods to solve business problems and make informed decisions. It combines a rigorous understanding of economic theory with practical business applications. This interdisciplinary approach equips graduates with analytical skills essential for careers in finance, consulting, market research, data analysis, and public policy. The program emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and effective communication, preparing students for success in a dynamic global economy. Our graduates go on to work in a variety of fields and for prestigious companies.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Business Management -
Requirements: Common Application or Sacred Heart University application; Official High School Transcript; Guidance Counselor Recommendation; One Essay; Test-Optional Policy: Sacred Heart University has a test-optional policy for applicants seeking fall or spring admission. Students may choose to apply without submitting SAT or ACT scores. If you choose to submit scores, they can be sent directly from the testing agency or reported on your official high school transcript. Students who do not submit test scores will not be disadvantaged in the application process.
Department: Jack Welch College of Business & Technology
Description: A broad-based business education. The Bachelor of Science in Business Management is designed to provide you with a comprehensive business education. You will develop an understanding of the business environment and the functional areas of business, including accounting, finance, marketing, management, and information systems. The program emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, preparing you for a wide range of careers in business or for graduate studies. The curriculum is designed to be flexible, allowing you to tailor your studies to your interests through elective courses and minors. You'll gain practical experience through internships, case studies, and real-world projects, ensuring you are career-ready upon graduation.
Accredidation: The Welch College of Business & Technology is accredited by AACSB International – The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business. AACSB accreditation is the hallmark of excellence in business education, earned by less than five percent of the world's business programs.
ScholarshipType: Merit-based, Athletic, Performing Arts, ROTC, Diocesan, Phi Theta Kappa

Description: The Catholic Studies Minor aims to introduce students to the richness of the Catholic tradition. The program takes an interdisciplinary approach, drawing from theology, history, philosophy, literature, and art. Students will engage with the intellectual, spiritual, and cultural aspects of Catholicism, exploring its historical development, theological foundations, ethical teachings, and its impact on Western civilization and contemporary society. Through critical inquiry and dialogue, students will develop a nuanced understanding of Catholicism, its contributions to humanity, and its continued relevance in the modern world.

Requirements:
All applicants must submit the following documents to be considered for admission to Sacred Heart University:
*   Common Application (including Essay) OR Sacred Heart University Application
*   Official High School Transcripts (9th-11th grades, and 12th grade if available)
*   Counselor Recommendation (Optional from a teacher)
*   Official SAT or ACT scores (see SHU Test-Optional Policy)
Sacred Heart University is test-optional for students applying for the Fall 2024 and Fall 2025 entry terms. Students will be given the choice to apply with or without submitting official SAT or ACT scores as part of their application. Choosing to apply test-optional will not adversely affect an applicant’s admission or scholarship review.
Description:
At Sacred Heart University, our Chemistry B.S. program is a robust, hands-on, research-based curriculum designed to prepare you for a range of professional careers or graduate studies. As a chemistry major, you’ll be immersed in all aspects of the chemical sciences, from foundational principles to advanced analytical techniques. Our approach emphasizes practical experience, critical thinking, and a deep understanding of chemical theories, ensuring you’re well-equipped for the scientific challenges of tomorrow. You’ll engage in laboratory work, research projects, and independent studies, all while benefitting from personalized mentorship from our dedicated faculty.
The chemistry curriculum is designed to provide you with a comprehensive understanding of the major sub-disciplines within chemistry: analytical, biochemistry, inorganic, organic, and physical chemistry. You'll gain extensive hands-on experience with modern instrumentation and experimental techniques, preparing you for immediate entry into the workforce or advanced graduate studies. Beyond the classroom, opportunities for research with faculty mentors abound, allowing you to contribute to cutting-edge scientific discoveries and present your work at national conferences. Our graduates are highly sought after in diverse fields, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, environmental science, and materials science, as well as medical and professional schools.

The chemistry minor is designed to supplement other majors, allowing students to gain foundational knowledge in chemistry, which is essential for understanding various scientific and technological fields. The minor provides a strong scientific background for students considering careers in healthcare, biotechnology, education, law, or engineering.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Arts in Communication Studies -
Requirements: To apply, first-year students need to submit: A completed Common Application or Sacred Heart University Application, Official high school transcripts, One letter of recommendation from a guidance counselor or teacher (We recommend a letter from a teacher), Application essay. Sacred Heart University is test-optional, meaning students have the choice of whether or not to submit SAT or ACT scores as part of their application package. If you choose to submit your scores, you may self-report them through your application or upload a copy of your scores to your application portal. Official scores will be required for students who enroll and submit their scores. Students who are applying for the following programs are required to submit SAT or ACT scores: Direct Entry Nursing, Occupational Therapy, Doctor of (Dual Degree), Physical Therapy, Doctor of (Dual Degree), Physician Assistant Studies (Dual Degree).
Concentration: Film & Television, Journalism & Media Production, Public Relations & Advertising, Sports Communication & Media
Description: Communication is all around us, in the language we speak, the art we create and the media we consume. It’s what connects us to each other and the world. As a communication studies major at Sacred Heart University, you'll delve into the vital role of communication in building effective relationships, solving problems, fostering understanding, and influencing change across diverse contexts. You will explore a broad range of communication areas including media studies, public relations, advertising, journalism, digital communication, and film and television production. Through a blend of theoretical knowledge and practical application, you'll develop expertise in critical analysis, strategic thinking, ethical decision-making, and effective communication across various platforms. Our curriculum emphasizes hands-on learning, collaborative projects, and real-world experiences, preparing you to thrive in a dynamic global society.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering -
Requirements: Official high school transcript, Essay, Guidance counselor recommendation, Official SAT or ACT scores (optional for most programs), Portfolio or audition (for certain programs, if applicable)
Description: In the Computer Engineering program, you will focus on the design and development of digital hardware and software systems. You will gain a deep understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, networks, and software engineering principles. The curriculum covers a wide range of topics, including digital signal processing, embedded systems, microprocessors, VLSI design, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. You'll work on practical projects and gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies. Our state-of-the-art facilities and experienced faculty will provide you with the tools and knowledge to succeed in the rapidly evolving field of computer engineering.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science -
Requirements: To apply to Sacred Heart University, please submit the following: Common Application or SHU Application, Official High School Transcripts, One Letter of Recommendation (counselor or teacher), Optional Essay, SAT/ACT Scores (see test-optional policy below), Personal Interview (recommended for undecided students or those in need of further assistance, but not required). Nursing applicants must submit an essay. Five-Year Bachelor's/Master's programs have additional requirements.
Description: The Computer Science BS program at Sacred Heart University offers a comprehensive curriculum that emphasizes both theoretical foundations and practical application. Students gain a deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, programming languages, operating systems, and computer networks, while also exploring emerging fields like artificial intelligence, machine learning, cybersecurity, and data science. The program fosters critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and innovation, preparing graduates for successful careers in a rapidly evolving technological landscape or for further graduate studies. Through hands-on projects, research opportunities, and internships, students develop the expertise to design, implement, and manage complex software systems and contribute to advancements in computing technology. Immerse yourself in the world of computing with our comprehensive Computer Science BS program. At Sacred Heart University, we go beyond the classroom, offering a dynamic curriculum that combines theoretical foundations with hands-on application. You'll explore a wide range of topics, from algorithms and data structures to artificial intelligence and cybersecurity, gaining the skills needed to thrive in today's technology-driven world. Our dedicated faculty, state-of-the-art facilities, and strong industry connections ensure you receive a top-tier education. With opportunities for research, internships, and capstone projects, you'll graduate ready to innovate and lead in the ever-evolving field of computer science.

The Computer Science minor at Sacred Heart University provides students with a foundational understanding of computer science principles and practices. This minor is an excellent complement to a variety of majors, enabling students to develop critical skills in computational thinking, programming, and problem-solving. It offers a flexible curriculum designed to introduce students to key areas such as software development, data structures, algorithms, and computing theory. Through hands-on projects and relevant coursework, students will gain valuable technical expertise that is highly sought after in today’s technology-driven world, preparing them for diverse career paths or further study in technology-related fields.

The Creative Writing minor at Sacred Heart University allows students to explore their creative potential through writing across various genres. Students develop their craft in fiction, poetry, creative nonfiction, screenwriting, and playwriting. Through workshops and seminars, students refine their voice, learn about literary techniques, and engage in critical discussions about contemporary and classic works. The minor culminates in a capstone project, where students produce a substantial piece of original creative work, demonstrating their mastery of chosen genres and their unique artistic vision.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Arts in Criminal Justice -
Requirements:
A completed application (either the Common Application or Sacred Heart University Application)
Official high school transcript
Letters of Recommendation (optional)
Personal Statement/Essay (optional)
Official standardized test scores (SAT/ACT) — Sacred Heart University is test-optional for most majors. Learn more about our test-optional policy.
Description:
At Sacred Heart University, our Bachelor of Arts in Criminal Justice program offers a comprehensive study of the American criminal justice system. You will explore the theoretical frameworks, institutional practices, and policy implications related to crime, deviance, and social control. Our curriculum is designed to provide you with a deep understanding of law enforcement, courts, corrections, and community-based programs.

As a Criminal Justice major, you will develop critical thinking, research, and analytical skills essential for careers in various criminal justice fields or for advanced study. Our program emphasizes ethical decision-making, social justice, and a commitment to serving diverse communities. You'll gain hands-on experience through internships and community engagement opportunities, preparing you for real-world challenges.

Requirements: Complete our online application (Common Application or Sacred Heart University application). Official high school transcripts from all high schools attended. A letter of recommendation from your high school counselor. Official SAT or ACT scores (recommended, but optional). A personal essay (required only if applying via Common Application). A non-refundable $50 application fee.
Description: Sacred Heart University’s Bachelor of Science in Cybersecurity program prepares students to protect computer systems and networks from cyber threats. Students will learn how to design, implement, and maintain secure systems, as well as how to detect and respond to cyberattacks. The curriculum covers a wide range of topics, including network security, cryptography, digital forensics, ethical hacking, and risk management. With a strong emphasis on hands-on learning, students will gain practical experience through labs, simulations, and real-world projects. Graduates will be well-prepared for careers in cybersecurity, including security analyst, security engineer, incident responder, and penetration tester.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Digital Marketing -
Requirements:
Students who complete the Common Application or SHU Application must submit the following materials:
- Common Application or SHU Application
- Official High School Transcript
- Secondary School Report and Counselor Recommendation
- Two Letters of Recommendation (optional)
- Essay (optional)
- SAT/ACT scores (optional for most programs, see "Test Optional Policy")
- Resume (optional)
- AP/IB scores (if applicable)
Department: Jack Welch College of Business & Technology
Description: Digital marketing uses web and social media channels to interact with consumers, create brands, and sell products and services. Sacred Heart’s Digital Marketing program provides students with the critical skills and knowledge needed for a successful career in a constantly evolving field. The program prepares students for positions in digital marketing strategy, social media marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), digital analytics, and content marketing. Students will learn how to: Identify opportunities to use digital tools to promote products, services, and brands. Formulate comprehensive digital marketing strategies. Create content for digital platforms. Measure the success of digital marketing efforts using analytics. Adapt to new digital technologies and trends.

Requirements: Students interested in declaring a minor in economics must have a cumulative GPA of 2.0 and have completed or be currently enrolled in EC 101 or EC 102.
Department: Jack Welch College of Business & Technology
Description: An economics minor is an excellent choice for students who want to broaden their understanding of resource allocation, decision-making, and market behavior. This minor complements a wide range of majors, including finance, marketing, political science, history, and even nursing. It equips students with valuable analytical skills and a strong foundation in economic principles that are applicable in virtually any field. Studying economics involves examining how individuals, businesses, and governments make choices when facing scarcity. This minor delves into both microeconomics (individual and firm behavior) and macroeconomics (broader economic trends like inflation, unemployment, and economic growth). Through a combination of theoretical knowledge and practical applications, students will learn to analyze economic issues, evaluate policies, and understand the forces that shape global economies.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering -
Requirements: Common Application or Sacred Heart University Application; Official High School Transcript(s); Counselor Recommendation (Common App only) or Secondary School Report; Optional: SAT/ACT Scores; Optional: Personal Essay.
Description: The Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering provides students with an education in the fundamental principles of electrical engineering in a broad range of areas. Graduates will be prepared for a variety of entry-level positions in industry or for advanced study. The Electrical Engineering program provides students with the opportunity to pursue an education that meets the requirements for a bachelor of science degree and satisfies requirements for professional engineering licensure. Students will learn the necessary skills in electrical engineering to analyze, design, and implement complex electrical systems. The curriculum emphasizes both theory and practical applications and hands-on laboratory experiences. A strong general education component helps students to develop written and oral communication skills along with problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
Accredidation: The Electrical Engineering program is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, https://www.abet.org.

Requirements: This minor is available to any student in any major at SHU. Students must maintain a 2.0 GPA in all courses that count towards the minor.
Department: School of Computer Science and Engineering
Description:
Engineers are problem solvers who use innovation, technology, and science to improve the world. Sacred Heart University’s engineering program provides students with a broad and foundational understanding of engineering principles while allowing them to develop specialized expertise through various electives. We offer engineering courses for both majors and non-majors, helping students develop an analytical mindset and critical thinking skills.
The Engineering Minor is available to all students seeking to develop a deeper understanding of engineering principles, enhance their critical thinking skills, and broaden their career opportunities. It complements a variety of majors, from science and mathematics to business and the liberal arts, providing a versatile skill set that is highly valued in today’s interdisciplinary professional landscape.
Our program provides a comprehensive engineering education through a unique blend of theoretical knowledge and practical experience.
